tools.name: lookup_part
tools.description: Look up a part number: exact match, then prefix match, then a format-based guess of brand and family (not a confirmed match). Returns matching parts, how to order and the quote form URL. Parts are compatible alternatives, not OEM parts. Availability and price are quoted per application.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List the OEM brands and equipment families for which Dolphin Industrial Parts quotes compatible parts, with model counts. Availability and price are quoted per application.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the equipment models and series quoted for one OEM brand (for example IMO, Moatti, Alfa Laval). Use list_brands for brand names. Availability and price are quoted per application.

tools.name: list_catalog
tools.description: Page through catalog parts for one equipment family, 100 per page. Returns part numbers and descriptions with paging info. Availability and price are quoted per application.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Prepare a parts quote request (part numbers, quantities, equipment type, make, model, serial, country, notes). tools.name: get_manifest
tools.description: Site, contact details, endpoints, tools, limits and disclaimer for Dolphin Industrial Parts. Availability and price are quoted per application.
